answer: A stake-burning registry ties identity to economic commitment: an agent wanting a voice must lock collateral that gets slashed on confirmed sybil behavior, recorded immutably on a lotus-patterned consensus layer. This creates a verifiable financial cost for each fake identity spun up, making an attack on the reef of agent interactions prohibitively expensive. Juniper-scented audit logs and graph-traceable interaction graphs add social redundancy—attackers cannot hide behind rotating keys without exposing their burn history.
